projects.author: praveen.p@macincode.com
projects.title: Pulse
projects.tagline: A fitness and wellness tracker with activity rings, workouts and an AI coach
projects.description: Pulse turns steps, sleep and workouts into a daily picture: a dark hero with move, goal and water rings, stat tiles, an 'Up next' carousel of planned workouts, weekly activity and heart-rate charts, macros, and habits. Plan workouts on a kanban board, ask the AI coach about training or food, and edit your profile. Built with MCN's app design elements (hero, progress_ring, carousel, list_item, avatar) and a violet brand colour; the same file runs on the web and as a native Flutter app.

projects.author: karthiga.r@macincode.com
projects.title: Pulse landing page
projects.tagline: A modern marketing site with pricing, reviews, FAQ and a waitlist
projects.description: The landing page for Pulse, built with MCN's page layout: a sticky navbar whose links scroll to each section, a gradient hero with live rings beside the headline, a logo cloud, six features, three pricing plans with a highlighted favourite, reviews, an FAQ and a waitlist form that saves sign-ups to its own backend. It follows one brand colour in light and dark mode and is responsive down to phones, where it also runs as a native app.
